featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m beyond disappointed and angry with how Fitness Heroes Gym treated me. Over two months ago, my earbud case was stolen inside the gym, from the same place where all members keep their belongings. Since that day, I’ve been asking them to check the CCTV footage, but no one has taken any action — they just keep ignoring it like nothing happened.

When I finally spoke to the owner, instead of helping, he spoke rudely and disrespectfully, saying things like “I’m not here to take care of your small belongings” and “It’s not my fault, it’s your responsibility.”
Seriously? The theft happened inside your gym, and this is how you talk to a member asking for help?

It’s been more than two months now — no update, no apology, no responsibility. The staff just don’t care at all. I trusted this place, but the way they’ve handled this shows zero professionalism, zero empathy, and zero accountability.

Would never recommend this gym to anyone. If your things get stolen here, be ready to be blamed instead of helped.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for sharing your concerns. We are sorry to hear about your experience.

We would like to clarify that, as stated in our policies, the gym is not responsible for the loss of personal items brought by members. To help avoid such incidents, we provide locker facilities for safely storing valuables such as earbuds, helmets, wallets, and phones. We always encourage members to use these lockers during their workouts.

Regarding your specific situation, our team reviewed the CCTV footage and also showed it to you. The recording clearly indicated that your earbud case was mistakenly picked up by another member, as both cases were identical and placed in the same area. This was an unfortunate misunderstanding rather than negligence from our staff.

Additionally, we kindly request that members avoid bringing used helmets onto the gym floor for safety and hygiene reasons. Helmets can be securely locked with your bike or stored in the lockers provided.

We value all feedback and are always open to addressing concerns directly so we can resolve any issues constructively. Please feel free to reach out to our management team if you need further assistance.

Thank you for your understanding.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I'm writing this review to express my concern about the steadily declining maintenance standards at this gym. Given the current condition of the facilities, I strongly feel that the monthly membership fee of ₹11,000 should be reduced to ₹10,000.

There are several persistent issues that have been left unaddressed:

No personal locker facility is available.

Tissue papers are often missing in the washrooms.

Cleanliness is below acceptable standards, with cockroaches frequently spotted on the floor.

These issues reflect poorly on the quality of service, especially considering the premium fees being charged.

Additionally, on May 7th, I visited to renew my membership and requested if my membership could be paused for June, as I’ll be traveling. The receptionist contacted the owner but couldn't reach him. I was told I couldn’t begin workouts until a decision was made. Despite clearly stating that I was still willing to renew, I was denied access. The trainer, Sahil, and the receptionist were extremely rude and made me wait unnecessarily.

As a long-standing member, this kind of treatment was very disappointing and showed a complete lack of customer support and respect. I considered not returning, but out of habit, I did only to realize that the attitude and service were simply not worth it.

Thankfully, I’ve now joined Gymathon in Mazgaon. They offered a 1.5-month free trial without any hassle and activated my membership exactly as requested, starting at the end of June. They also provide personal lockers and a steamer facility all at the same ₹11,000.

So, in hindsight, I’m grateful for the poor experience here it led me to a far better one elsewhere.
